usedFor: Gtwy runs your AI platform, and Google Sheets logs it when “Missing Variable Alert” runs “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “Missing Variable Alert” in Gtwy, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each alert about a missing variable becomes a row, so repeated setup problems are easy to count and sort.

watchOut: Every “Missing Variable Alert” adds a row, so one unresolved problem can fill the sheet with repeats.
